statement: Thrust-to-weight at nominal pack voltage is at least 3:1
rationale: A first-time pilot in angle mode hovers at 1/TW of full thrust; at 3:1 that is a third of the stick, leaving room to arrest a fall and push through a gust. At ~2:1 the quad wallows and a beginner's late correction cannot catch it. Commercial 1S whoops run 3.5-5:1.
